app.name: Mahlzeit
app.offline: You are offline. Changes need a connection.
app.loadFailed: Could not load. Check your connection.

login.title: Sign in
login.noAccount: New here? Accounts are created by invitation only.

join.title: Join Mahlzeit
join.enterCode: Enter the code from your invitation.
join.householdInvite: You are invited to start your own household on Mahlzeit.

status.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask for a new one.
status.accepted: This invitation has already been used.

join.signedIn: You are signed in as {{name}}. Sign out first to use this invitation.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.intro: Enter your email. If it belongs to an account, we will send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If the address is known, a link is on its way. It is valid for one hour.
forgot.disabled: This server cannot send email. Ask the person who runs it to reset your password with the admin command “mahlzeit reset-password”.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.done: Your password is set. You can sign in now.

invite.title: Invite your partner
invite.explain: Share the link, or read out the code. It works once and for seven days.
invite.full: A household has room for {{max}} people.

settings.title: Settings
settings.privacyIntro: Your food log and targets are always visible to your household, because planning together depends on them.

push.testSent: Sent. It should arrive in a few seconds.
push.unsupported: This browser does not support notifications. Install the app or use Chrome.
push.notConfigured: Notifications are not set up on this server.
push.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site in the browser settings.

password.title: Password
password.changed: Password changed. Your other devices are signed out.

install.title: App
install.installed: Mahlzeit is installed on this device.
install.hint: To install, open the browser menu and choose “Install app” or “Add to home screen”.

about.title: About
about.privacy: Mahlzeit runs on your own server. Your data stays there; nothing is sent to an AI provider unless you switch that on.
about.attribution: Food data sources are named here once the catalogue is added.
